title: Nearly Tight Almost Sure Convergence Rates for the Last iterate of SGD
abstract: arXiv:2611.24151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the almost sure convergence of the last-iterate optimization error of Stochastic (sub)Gradient Descent (SGD) for convex objectives. For smooth objectives, we establish convergence rates of order $k^{-1/3}$ when a stationary minimizer exists, and $k^{-1/4}$ otherwise, up to polylogarithmic factors, where $k$ denotes the iteration counter. We further show that the latter rate extends to nonsmooth convex objectives. All these rates are achieved by deterministic, anytime stepsize policies. Finally, we establish matching lower bounds showing that the exponents $-1/3$ and $-1/4$ are optimal, up to polylogarithmic factors, for the corresponding problem classes.

translated_title: SGD最后迭代点几乎必然收敛速率的近乎紧致结果
translated_abstract: 我们研究了随机（次）梯度下降（SGD）在凸目标函数上最后迭代点优化误差的几乎必然收敛性。对于光滑目标函数，当存在稳定极小值点时，我们建立了 $k^{-1/3}$ 阶的收敛速率，否则为 $k^{-1/4}$ 阶（在相差多对数因子的意义下），其中 $k$ 表示迭代计数。我们进一步证明后一种速率可以推广到非光滑凸目标函数。所有这些速率均通过确定性的、随时可用的步长策略实现。最后，我们建立了匹配的下界，表明指数 $-1/3$ 和 $-1/4$ 在相差多对数因子的意义下，对于相应的问题类别是最优的。
tldr: 该论文为SGD最后迭代点的几乎必然收敛建立了近乎紧致的速率界——光滑情形下分别为 $k^{-1/3}$（存在稳定极小点）和 $k^{-1/4}$（且后者可推广至非光滑凸情形），并通过匹配下界证明这些指数在相差多对数因子的意义下是最优的。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes nearly tight almost sure convergence rates for the last iterate of SGD—$k^{-1/3}$ for smooth objectives with a stationary minimizer and $k^{-1/4}$ otherwise (which extends to nonsmooth convex objectives)—and proves the optimality of these exponents via matching lower bounds up to polylogarithmic factors.
